description: Sets the account's name, company, use case (what you are building) and language (the language for emails and the dashboard). Send only the fields to change; an empty string clears a text field. Free. Returns the updated profile. Needs an API key or a connected account.

locale.description: The language for emails and the dashboard: one of en, es, de, fr, ja, pt-BR. A language that isn't published yet reads in English until it is.

name.description: Your name, used in emails ("Hey {first name},").

use_case.description: What you are building with boundaries and areas.

name: update_profile
title: Update profile
